intro_1.asr: Imagine pointing your smartphone at almost anything and instantly discovering information about it.

intro_2.asr: a product, a plant, a famous landmark or even, a page of handwritten notes.

intro_3.asr: Google Lens makes this possible using artificial intelligence and visual search technology.

intro_4.asr: But how does it actually work?

intro_5.asr: In this video, we will explore the technology behind Google Lens, step by step.

what_1.asr: Google Lens is a visual search tool developed by Google.

what_2.asr: Instead of typing words into a search bar, you can use your camera or an existing image to search for information.

what_3.asr: Google Lens analyzes what it sees and helps you discover relevant results.

what_4.asr: It can recognize objects, identify landmarks, extract text, translate signs and help you find similar products online.

what_5.asr: The idea is simple, use an image as your search query.

what_6.asr: this makes searching more natural, especially when you don't know the name of samathin or when describing it with words would be difficult.

scan_1.asr: When you point your camera at an object, the first step is capturing an image.

scan_2.asr: The system processes visual information such as shapes, tellers, textures, patterns and the relationships between different parts of the image.

scan_3.asr: Machine learning models analyze this information to develop an understanding of what might be present.

scan_4.asr: For example, when you scan a sneaker, the system can identify visual features that resemble footwear.

scan_5.asr: It may also distinguish specific characteristics such as its color, style and design.

scan_6.asr: these visual clues help the system understand what to search for next.

ai_1.asr: One of the technologies that makes Google Lens possible is computer vision, a field of artificial intelligence focused on understanding images and videos.

ai_2.asr: AI models learn visual patterns from large collections of training examples.

ai_3.asr: When a new image is analyzed, the model uses its learned patterns to recognize possible objects and visual features.

ai_4.asr: Modern visual search systems can also use sophisticated models to understand how different elements of an image relate to one another.

ai_5.asr: Rather than simply looking for an identical picture, the system can use visual similarities and context to help identify relevant information.

results_1.asr: After analyzing the image, Google Lens can use its visual understanding to find relevant search results.

results_2.asr: Let's imagine that you scan a pair of sneakers.

results_3.asr: Google Lens may show visually similar shoes, product listings, shopping information and useful web pages.

results_4.asr: The results can help you learn more about the style of find places where similar products are available.

results_5.asr: Visual search is especially useful for clothing, furniture, accessories and everyday objects.

results_6.asr: Instead of trying to describe the exact shape and color of a product, you can simply show the camera what you are looking for.

text_1.asr: Google Lens can also work with text inside images.

text_2.asr: And this is made possible by Optical Character Recognition, commonly known as OCR, combined with other language processing technologies.

text_3.asr: When you point your camera at a printed page or sign, lens can detect the text and allow you to copy it, search for it or translate it.

text_4.asr: Imagine traveling to another country and seeing the sign written in a language you don't understand.

text_5.asr: Google Lens can help translate that text and display the result on your screen.

text_6.asr: You can also use it to copy information from books, notes and documents without typing everything manually.

uses_1.asr: Google Lens can be useful in many everyday situations.

uses_2.asr: If you see an unfamiliar plant, you can scan it to explore possible matches and learn more about it.

uses_3.asr: If you are visiting the famous location, visual search may help you identify a landmark and discover its history.

uses_4.asr: If you see a product you like, you can search for similar items without knowing the brand or model.

uses_5.asr: You can also translate menus, copy printed text and search for information related to objects around you.

uses_6.asr: However, AI recognition is not always perfect.

uses_7.asr: Results can vary depending on image quality, lighting and the information available.

howto_2.asr: Open the Google app or another supported place where Lens is available and select the Google Lens icon.

howto_3.asr: You can point your camera at something you want to explore or choose an existing picture from your device.

howto_4.asr: position the object clearly inside the camera view and capture or select the image as needed.

howto_5.asr: lens will analyze it and display relevant options or search results.

howto_6.asr: Depending on the content, you can explore matching products, copy text, translate words or discover additional information.

outro_1.asr: Google Lens brings together computer vision, artificial intelligence, text recognition, and visual search to make everyday information easier to discover.

outro_2.asr: Instead of searching only with words, we can now explore the world using images.

outro_3.asr: From identifying objects to translating text, visual search is changing how we interact with information.

outro_4.asr: Google Lens is one example of how AI connects the physical world with digital knowledge.
